title: Menu View
description: Presentation-only menu tree for a catalog. If availability is provided here, it takes precedence over item availability.

catalog_id.description: Catalog identifier this menu view presents.

availability.description: Menu-level availability. When present, it overrides item availability.

tree.description: Root menu nodes (groups or item references).

external_ids.description: Provider identifiers for this menu view.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the menu view.
